capabilities.name: Elixir source and macro semantics
capabilities.reason: Focused compile rejection, quote metadata, guard and capture comparisons; complete language conformance is not established.

capabilities.name: Runtime code evaluation
capabilities.reason: Fresh interpreted-module public calls, captures, reflection and exceptions; full generated-module introspection and native replacement remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Erlang preprocessing
capabilities.reason: Scalar conditions and defined macros compared to OTP EPP; unsupported forms are explicit errors.

capabilities.name: Managed native resource lifetimes
capabilities.reason: Reclamation, moving GC, process/ETS copies, live ETF recovery and explicit native NIF keep/release ownership.

capabilities.name: TCP UDP and TLS semantics
capabilities.reason: Framing, delivery modes, socket settings and TLS callback policy compared to BEAM; backend and protocol gaps remain.

capabilities.name: Native Mix workflows
capabilities.reason: Tests, filters, umbrella projects, source generators and relocatable releases; unsupported Mix/ERTS protocols remain explicit.

capabilities.name: Locked Req package portability
capabilities.reason: Req 0.7.5 GET/POST/redirect/status with unchanged package sources; optional adapters and codecs are not fully covered.

capabilities.name: BEAM artifact loading and hot code replacement
capabilities.reason: Native executables do not load BEAM bytecode or implement ERTS release upgrade protocols.

capabilities.name: Dirty NIF schedulers and prebuilt NIF binaries
capabilities.reason: Supported C NIF sources are linked into the native executable and calls run on the calling scheduler thread.
